topStories.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq Hit Fresh Records on Palantir Blowout and Iran Deal Optimism
topStories.summary: S&P 500 surged 1.79% to 7,736 and Nasdaq jumped 2.59% to 26,585 on Tuesday, driven by Palantir's earnings beat and easing US-Iran tensions that sent oil lower.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY ↑, QQQ ↑, DIA ↑; crude oil ↓ on Middle East diplomatic progress easing supply fears

topStories.headline: Palantir Surges 29% After 'Otherworldly' Q2 — Revenue Up 93%, Full-Year Guidance Raised
topStories.summary: Palantir posted Q2 revenue of $1.94B (+93% YoY) with US commercial revenue up 149%, and raised its full-year guidance to $8.16B — CEO Alex Karp called the quarter 'otherworldly.'
topStories.marketImpact: PLTR ↑ 29%; AI software cohort broadly ↑; confirms sustained enterprise AI monetization

topStories.headline: SpaceX's AI Capex Surge Sinks Stock ~9% After Hours Despite Revenue Beat
topStories.summary: In its first post-IPO quarterly report, SpaceX beat revenue estimates ($7.8B vs $6.81B expected) but AI capex hit $15.8B — nearly double the prior quarter and far above the $13.09B forecast — rattling investors.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↓ ~9% AH; AI capex concern weighs on cloud and infrastructure names heading into Wednesday

topStories.headline: AMD Beats Q2 on Record Revenue But Q3 Guidance Disappointment Sends Stock Down 8% After Hours
topStories.summary: AMD reported record Q2 revenue of $11.54B (+50% YoY) with data center sales up 107%, but Q3 guidance of $13B missed elevated buy-side estimates, triggering an 8% post-market selloff.
topStories.marketImpact: AMD ↓ ~8% AH; illustrates the sharply elevated bar for AI chipmakers entering the second half

topStories.headline: Jeff Bezos Files to Sell $4 Billion in Amazon Shares After Stock Crosses $3 Trillion
topStories.summary: Bezos filed to sell ~15 million Amazon shares (~$4.1B) through a pre-arranged plan days after Amazon became the fifth company ever to cross a $3 trillion market cap.
topStories.marketImpact: AMZN ↓ ~2%; insider overhang tempers momentum at record highs; Jim Cramer called it a 'buzzkill'

topStories.headline: HKEX Launches World's First Offshore Chinese Sovereign Bond Futures
topStories.summary: Hong Kong Exchanges (HKEX) listed the world's first offshore Chinese government bond futures — a 5-year, cash-settled contract — on August 3, giving global managers holding ~2 trillion yuan in Chinese sovereign debt a new hedging tool.
topStories.marketImpact: 0388.HK ↑; reinforces Hong Kong's offshore yuan hub status; watch for increased cross-border bond inflows

topStories.headline: China CSRC Backs Hong Kong Firms for Mainland Listings, Plans REITs on Stock Connect
topStories.summary: China's top securities regulator announced support for HK-listed companies to pursue mainland IPOs and bond issuance onshore, and plans to add REITs to the Stock Connect, deepening cross-border capital market integration.
topStories.marketImpact: HK IPO pipeline ↑; 0388.HK (HKEX) ↑; broad HK-listed financials ↑ on policy tailwinds

topStories.headline: Nikkei Gains 2.7%, KOSPI Surges 4.5% as AI Chip Stocks Lead Asia Rally; Kioxia Unveils Denser NAND
topStories.summary: Asian markets surged following Wall Street's overnight gains, led by SK Hynix, SoftBank, and Kioxia; Kioxia also announced a new QLC 3D NAND flash generation with ~60% higher bit density than its predecessor.
topStories.marketImpact: 9984.T (SoftBank) ↑; 000660.KS (SK Hynix) ↑; Japan and Korea semiconductor names broadly ↑

topStories.headline: Hong Kong GDP Expands 4.3% in Q2; Full-Year Growth Forecast to Be Upgraded to ~4%
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's economy grew 4.3% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, beating expectations, prompting authorities to signal an upgrade to their full-year GDP growth forecast.
topStories.marketImpact: HKD assets ↑; supportive for Hong Kong-listed financials and property stocks

tickerDescriptions.SPY: SPDR S&P 500 ETF, tracking the 500 largest US companies by market capitalisation
tickerDescriptions.QQQ: Invesco QQQ ETF, tracking the Nasdaq-100 index of the 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq-listed companies
tickerDescriptions.DIA: SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF, tracking the 30 blue-chip stocks in the Dow Jones index
tickerDescriptions.PLTR: Palantir Technologies Inc., AI-powered data analytics and software platform serving US government agencies and commercial enterprises
tickerDescriptions.SPCX: SpaceX Inc., aerospace company operating Falcon/Starship launch vehicles, Starlink satellite internet, and AI platforms post-xAI integration
tickerDescriptions.AMD: Advanced Micro Devices Inc., designer of EPYC server CPUs and Instinct AI accelerators competing with NVIDIA in data centre AI infrastructure
tickerDescriptions.AMZN: Amazon.com Inc., global e-commerce giant and operator of AWS, the world's leading cloud platform
tickerDescriptions.0388.HK: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Ltd. (HKEX), operator of Hong Kong's stock, derivatives, and commodities markets
tickerDescriptions.9988.HK: Alibaba Group Holding, China's largest e-commerce and cloud computing conglomerate listed in Hong Kong
tickerDescriptions.0700.HK: Tencent Holdings Ltd., China's largest social media, gaming, and cloud computing company listed in Hong Kong
tickerDescriptions.9984.T: SoftBank Group Corp., Japanese technology investment conglomerate with major holdings in ARM, OpenAI, and AI ventures via Vision Fund
tickerDescriptions.000660.KS: SK Hynix Inc., South Korean memory semiconductor maker and leading producer of HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) AI chips
tickerDescriptions.0005.HK: HSBC Holdings plc, global banking and financial services group with major operations in Asia and Hong Kong

quickHits: Apple and Nvidia trade near all-time highs as AI capex debate intensifies across this week's earnings slate (Bloomberg).
Kioxia and SanDisk jointly launched a new QLC 3D NAND flash generation with ~60% higher bit density than prior products, lifting memory upgrade cycle expectations (TradingKey).
US weekly initial jobless claims land Thursday Aug 6; July nonfarm payrolls (consensus: ~85K vs June's soft 57K) drop Friday Aug 7 — the week's highest-impact macro event.
South Korea's KOSPI leads global equity gains, up 4.5%, as the AI chip trade re-accelerates behind Wall Street's outsized overnight rally (TradingKey).
